verdicts_or_reports.expected: Incomplete quests show current/target progress and a progress bar.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Incomplete permanent quest rows show only title, objective and Go to Skill, with no progress. Daily rows do show progress. Reproduced by switching categories and returning.
steps: Open Quests > Gathering; inspect Fishing II and Mining II.
Switch to Crafting Skills; inspect Construction I and Cooking quests.
Return between categories; progress remains absent.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Only genuinely outdated equipment qualifies; preserve best usable gear per slot and special-purpose capes.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Preview includes every unequipped armor piece including Runite Platebody, both helmets, Gilded and Slayer platebodies and Agility/Mercantile capes despite no superior replacements in their slots. Reopening reproduces.
steps: With starting inventory and Keep one off, open Shop > Sell > Sell Old Gear.
Scroll preview to bottom: Runite Platebody, Slayer Platebody and Steel Full Helmet are selected.
Cancel then reopen and scroll; same candidates recur.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Preserve useful crafting inputs, including materials used indirectly through processing and non-crafting uses.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Sell Junk selects Cowhide x14, Feather x60 and Wool x7 along with Pumpkin and Tomato. Cowhide and Wool are processing inputs and feathers are useful for arrows; these should not be unused junk.
steps: Starting inventory, Keep one off, open Shop > Sell > Sell Junk.
Observe Cowhide, Feather and Wool in sale preview.
Cancel and reopen; all three remain selected.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The player's completed permanent quests remain completed; quest log should not expose developer/debug reset actions.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Every completed permanent quest has a Reset button. Tapping Fishing I Reset immediately cleared its completion and removed Fishing II with no confirmation. Smithing I also exposes Reset.
steps: Open Quests > Gathering with initial completed Fishing I, Mining I and Woodcutting I.
Observe Reset below each Completed label.
Tap Fishing I Reset: completion disappears and Fishing II vanishes.
Open Crafting Skills and scroll to Smithing I; Reset appears there too.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Quest log rows show the rewards/bonuses for completing each quest so players can see what they earned or will earn.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Gathering and Crafting Skills permanent quest rows omit all reward information: only name, Go to Skill, objective, and Completed/Reset on completed rows are visible. No coin, XP or permanent bonus details are shown.
steps: Open Quests > Gathering.
Inspect completed Mining I and Woodcutting I and incomplete Mining II.
Switch to Crafting Skills and inspect Smithing I, then return to Gathering; rewards remain absent.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Unsellable skill capes are excluded from old-gear candidates and total; preview matches actual sale.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After selling other gear, preview still offers Agility Cape ×1 (6) and Mercantile Cape ×1 (6), Total 12. Sell All reports 0 coins and both capes remain. Repeated the cape-only sale twice. Initial preview was 5,428 but history records 5,416.
steps: Set Keep one off and open Sell Old Gear.
Preview includes Agility Cape and Mercantile Cape; confirm sale.
Open Sell Old Gear again: capes only, Total 12.
Confirm Sell All: Sold old equipment for 0 coins; capes remain.
Repeat: same 12 preview and 0 result.
